g.text: Layers: each layer wraps the one above in its own header
Left: the 7-layer model. Right: what a packet actually looks like on the wire.
Ethernet frame [ dst MAC | src MAC | type ] <- Layer 2
IP packet [ src IP | dst IP | TTL ] <- Layer 3
TCP / UDP segment [ src port | dst port ] <- Layer 4
Per hop: the Layer-2 header is stripped and rebuilt with new MACs. Layers 3 and 4 stay intact - unless NAT rewrites them.
